capabilities: Track daily habits in a clickable grid rendered from a code block
Count and display streaks with optional gap tolerance (maxGap)
Customize habit titles and colors via habit-file frontmatter
Open the daily note for a date by clicking it in the grid header
Configure per-tracker options (path, date range, colors, debug) in code block settings
extras: Clicking a date to open a daily note requires the Daily Notes core plugin or the Periodic Notes community plugin; without one, a notice appears on click. Habit data is stored in an "entries" frontmatter array managed by the plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track daily habits and visualize completion streaks inside notes.

relations.evidence: Requires the Daily Notes core plugin or the Periodic Notes community plugin
Ensure either the Daily Notes core plugin or the Periodic Notes community plugin is enabled

summary: Habit tracker that renders a clickable grid of habits and days in a code block, with streak counts and per-habit frontmatter settings.
